Please select one of the following: Location Help Critical Fire Weather Conditions in the Plains; Heavy Snow in the Sierra and Northern Rockies Gusty winds and warm, very dry conditions will lead to a Critical Risk of fire weather across much of the High Plains through Thursday. A Pacific storm system will bring strong winds and precipitation from the Pacific Northwest to the Northern Rockies, with heavy mountain snow in the Sierra-Nevada and northern Rockies.
